name: Treatment Room
narrativeOnEnter: An electroshock treatment table dominates the centre — leather restraints still buckled. A metal fuse panel on the far wall is open, wires hanging loose. A handwritten diagram is taped above it. The records vault requires power from this room.

hotspots.label: Records Vault
hotspots.lockedMessage: The vault door is electronically sealed — the lock needs power. Restore power from the fuse panel.

action.text:
A handwritten diagram taped above the fuse panel.

Each coloured wire must be connected to its matching socket:
  Red    → Red socket
  Blue   → Blue socket
  Green  → Green socket
  Yellow → Yellow socket
  White  → White socket

A note underneath:
'Sockets are scrambled — drag each wire to its colour match.
DO NOT cross connections — short circuit will trigger alarm.'

Note, unsigned:

'Director Harlan has the master key. It's in his safe.
The safe code is the year Blackwood was founded.

The vault holds the office key. Fix the power first.'

An electroconvulsive therapy table. Thick leather restraint straps — still buckled — hold the shape of a body that is no longer there.

The table's steel surface is cold. Scratch marks run along the right side.
